en.title: Luis Cedillo — AI Full-Stack Engineer & Technical Founder
en.description: I build AI products across web, mobile, APIs and cloud, from marketing execution to financial operations. A portfolio told as one night of work inside a 3D room.
en.headline: AI Full-Stack Engineer & Technical Founder
en.window: I build AI products across web, mobile, APIs and cloud.
en.note: If it doesn't add up, I explain it to the duck.
en.posterAlt: An isometric pixel-art room at night: a tuxedo cat codes in front of three monitors.
en.canvasLabel: The room in 3D. The camera moves as you scroll; drag sideways to look around.
